hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */./* | */../*) ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.rs) if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && rustfmt --edition 2024 "$f" && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/blank-lines-hook cargo xtask blank-lines --fix "$f"; fi ;; esac >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
